prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also listing 'text/event-stream'), returning an unnecessary 406 error. prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs edit the identical Accept-header check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts to fix the same 406 bug. #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that properly tokenizes the header (splits on commas/semicolons, trims, lowercases) and explicitly excludes entries with q=0 and handles type/subtype wildcard matching. #2046 instead does a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which is a narrower fix that can false-positive on headers containing 'application/json' as a substring of another token (e.g. 'application/json-seq') or inside a parameter, and does not account for q=0 exclusions. #1996's tokenized parsing handles more Accept-header edge cases for the same underlying defect.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs edit the identical Accept-header check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts to fix the same 406 bug. #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that properly tokenizes the header (splits on commas/semicolons, trims, lowercases) and explicitly excludes entries with q=0 and handles type/subtype wildcard matching. #2046 instead does a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which is a narrower fix that can false-positive on headers containing 'application/json' as a substring of another token (e.g. 'application/json-seq') or inside a parameter, and does not account for q=0 exclusions. #1996's tokenized parsing handles more Accept-header edge cases for the same underlying defect.
